name: Amanita
source:
Amanita lives quietly with her sisters in the shade of the caves. She’s a kind soul, but her dreamlike manner makes her feel almost otherworldly. She’ll happily share her food and wisdom if you can get used to her unusual ways.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4014730/Harem_of_Ankhutep/]Steam[/url]]
